title:
Quality changes under within-class and between-class replacement
of half the team
caption: Ordinary Manual, TARGET_DSTRUCT K3 working labels, n=14 and m=7. A is the original team, B the within-class replacement, and C the between-class replacement. title:
Structural and quality changes under half-team replacement
across image difficulty levels
caption: TARGET K3, 14/7. Bars are image-equal means from saved metric-specific summaries, not confidence intervals. Among nine scoreable difficult images, turns increase in 9/9 and Q in 7/9; structural retention and quality are distinct outcomes. Reference-node recall uses the source 5-degree matching definition.
selection: n=14; three difficulty levels; metric-specific support

title:
Cross-view consistency of quality changes
under half-team replacement within the same room
caption: Ordinary comparable Manual, TARGET K3 working direction 2 to 3. Each point is a physical pair of room views. GS denotes symmetric excess between-class magnitude; CB denotes C-B. The 10/5 subset has 268 physical events, 237 with all six endpoints scoreable, across 19 pairs and 7 buildings. The 14/7 subset has 10 events, 6 jointly scoreable, only 2 pairs and one fixed incoming seven-person block.
selection: TARGET K3; ordinary comparable; Manual; B8L2; direction 2→3; n/m=10/5 or14/7

title:
Prediction errors for annotation quality
using same-room and annotator-history information
caption: Current ordinary no-relation-pending scope: 65 images and 13 buildings. Image predictions use 128 direct pairs; individual predictions use the same 1,793 target answers (5,198 prediction rows). Panels have different prediction targets and should not be ranked against each other. Source-level image weighting is retained.
selection: v21_all; B8L2; ordinary_no_relation_oos_pending; person budget single_direct, stage single

title:
Changes in structural-expression differences between slower and faster
annotators across difficulty levels
caption: Bars use the saved same-people-pair means of (slow-fast on difficult images) minus (slow-fast on easy images). Frozen v2 pairs are rescored on v2.1; current TARGET K3 and the exact old/current support overlap are separate designs. Matching uses outside-building history, not target-image Q. The overlap is not a replacement for the full current support.
selection: Manual; origin=new; frozen V3 versus current TARGET K3; turn_n/short_turn_edges

title:
Consensus quality and variability across team-size intervals
under natural annotation arrival
caption: Fixed 171 ordinary Manual images with at least 30 eligible annotators. Each bar is an image-equal change in a per-image statistic under natural random orderings. Mean, P10 and SD are conditional on scoreability; actual fusion failures are separately measured. These are interval contrasts, not a complete arrival curve or an optimized-team experiment.

title:
Quality and recorded labor of Q/T-selected teams relative to Q-only teams
on fixed candidate support
caption: 126 common source-target contexts, 46 images, 9 buildings, fixed across n=3,4,5,6,7,9,13. Points and 95% empirical building-resampling intervals are copied from the accepted saved summaries (20,000 replicates), Contexts are equally weighted within target images, then images within buildings, then buildings. Labor ratios are aggregated on the log scale and exponentiated; they are not ratios of summed labor. Metric-specific scoreability is retained. At n=5, delta Q=0.218 and labor ratio=0.813. Q/T teams can be non-nested across sizes. This is not natural arrival.
selection: panel=all_sizes_3_to_13; delta_q/labor_ratio/loss_gt5; saved value and bootstrap limits
